hookstep_separated_from_line_search_by: delta -> 0 rotates the step onto -J^T F, cos = 1.00000000 (full Krylov space; on a truncated space the limit is that gradient PROJECTED onto span(Q_k), measured cos = 0.73, which is why the check is run at full dimension)

on F(x)=A(x+10x^3), cond(A)=1e3, dim 6, Krylov 5 -- where J = A diag(1+30x^2) is nonsingular everywhere so ||F|| provably has no spurious local minimum -- leg 353's own 8-halving line search returns line_search_failed at |F|=5.030 and STILL stalls at |F|=3.967 with 200 halvings, while the hookstep converges to |F|=1.95e-10 in 51 iterations: the deficit is the DIRECTION, not the halving budget

units.what_the_run_found: the solver WORKS and converges reproducibly: 14/100 attempts reached tol=1e-8 (14% per attempt, above Chandler & Kerswell 4.3% and Lucas & Kerswell ~10%), best ||R|| = 8.67e-12, onto EIGHT distinct relative periodic orbits of the discrete map, three of them replicated from independent seeds and different anchors (T=16.53/|s|=0.100 four times agreeing to 0.012 in T and 0.002 in |s|; T=16.87/|s|=0.073 four times; T=19.29/|s|=0.117 twice). NONE is a named Table IV row, so n_recovered = 0 and the gate is unmoved.
units.why_the_misses_are_systematic: a SECOND selection bias, structurally identical to the one AMENDMENT 4 fixed in period, one dimension over. Converged |s| in [0.073, 0.317], 12 of 14 below 0.14; published |s| in [0.295, 0.707]. Over the library's 1153 m=0 candidates the rank correlation corr(|s|, R) = 0.50 and admission by R<0.25 falls monotonically with shift: 44% for |s|<0.15, 20%, 11% in the published band, 3% above 0.75. Admitted pool median |s| = 0.112; all candidates median |s| = 0.824. The large-shift recurrences EXIST in the DNS; the Newton window removes them. Newton converges near its seed, so the pool's shift distribution propagates to the solution set. UNFIXED -- it was not anticipated and stratifying by shift is a new build unit.
errata_against_my_own_prereg: the envelope arithmetic ignored Pool.map chunking (chunksize 3 -> 34 chunks -> a 12-attempt tail worker, not 10 balanced rounds); errs safe, cost wall time only
per-epoch cost underestimated ~1.7x: probe 54.7 s/epoch vs ~95 s/epoch measured; probable cause is that the probe did not run at ten-way concurrency. Successors should cost at 95.

THE ONE THAT MATTERS: the cost model behind max_newton_required=238 does not describe the observed behaviour. Convergence is bimodal -- all 14 convergences finished in <=29 epochs (median 16) while the 86 non-convergences ran to the cap and were FLAT there (53% reduced ||R|| by <1% over their final 10 epochs, 83% by <10%, 3% still halving, median final ||R|| = 2.11). Max Krylov dimension over the whole run was 25 against max_gmres=140. NEITHER CAP BOUND ANY ATTEMPT THAT CONVERGED. UNDER-RESOURCED stays the correct pre-committed branch, but the named compliant cost (36.2 h, 15.1 core-days) is the WRONG PURCHASE: buying 238 epochs extends 86 already-flat sequences.
units.lesson_91_what_this_negative_names: a first-order-in-time realization (Lie-Trotter, measured global ratio 2.00 not 4.00), a residual with a continuous x-shift only and no m unknown (345 in-window candidates could not be EXPRESSED as seeds; all eight named rows have m_published=0 so nothing named is lost), and a seed pool whose admission filter is monotone in |s|. NOT "the orbits are not there"; NOT "Newton cannot find them" -- it found eight others.
successor_order: 1. stratify the seed budget by SHIFT as AMENDMENT 4 did for period: 395 m=0 candidates already lie in the published band, 11% already inside the window. Cheapest untried action, targets the measured cause.
2. replace or condition the R<0.25 admission test, which is confounded with |s|
3. add an m unknown to the residual (realization change, invalidates M1's reproduction, needs its own milestone)
4. buy iterations LAST -- the bimodality makes this the lowest-yield spend
